$comment: Tamarind Grove University — a demonstration pack, not a real customer.
The name, the one-word short name and the tagline are invented so that no
real institution's name, initials or town can be read into a sales demo.
It exists to prove the derivation engine on a hue nothing else in the
registry uses. A deep maroon with a gold accent is the most common
identity in South Indian higher education, and it is the palette most
likely to be pasted into the branding studio on a first sales call.
Rounded corners and a serif display face are the other axis: this pack
should feel like a different product from ifbash.json, using the same
components and one JSON file of difference.
Its copy claims nothing the shared fixture register contradicts: that
register runs 2013 to the current year, so there is no founding year and
no 'thirty years of graduates' on the first screen of a sales demo.
